title: Production Recovery durable evidence, readiness, and integrity closure

phases.objective: Keep Production Recovery mutation fail-closed while preserving a qualified independent durable evidence authority across process restarts, validating the Recovery control-store schema through read-only information_schema probes, rejecting tampered persisted payloads, and deriving live readiness from actual composition state rather than caller claims.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A fresh Recovery store instance over the same backing state can read the persisted run, plan, finding and idempotency evidence; any payload whose stored SHA-256 no longer matches is rejected; readiness reports degraded rather than mutating schema when the durable evidence layout is incomplete; Production live-state consistency is derived from actual composition instead of a legacy caller signal.
steps: Create the Recovery control-store through the canonical shared durable-store contract.
Persist a sanitized run, plan, finding, idempotency receipt and append-only evidence event.
Discard the first store instance and construct a fresh instance over the same backing state to simulate process restart.
Read back the persisted evidence and prove it is independent from in-process Recovery maps.
Modify persisted payload_json without updating payload_sha256 and require the store to fail closed with an integrity error.
Probe the independent Recovery control database through ping plus information_schema column/index reads only.
When a required durable evidence column is absent, return schema_not_ready with database_mutation_performed=false and schema_auto_apply=false.
Qualify durable inspection and mutation-grade stores through one shared validator contract while keeping execution-ticket verification an additional mutation-grade requirement.
Compute Production live-state consistency from the actual Recovery composition and prove the legacy caller live-enabled signal cannot activate mutation authority.
assertions: Durable Recovery evidence survives a process/store restart over the same backing store.
Readback validates payload_sha256 before trusting persisted Recovery snapshots.
Execution-ticket payload identity must match the stored ticket_hash.
Recovery control-store readiness uses read-only information_schema probes and never auto-applies schema.
The Recovery control DB remains independent from runtime, governance and runtime-persistence target databases.
The shared durable-store contract distinguishes evidence-grade durability from mutation-grade authority.
Actual Recovery composition state is authoritative for Production live readiness; legacy caller signals cannot enable mutation authority.
recovery_live_state_consistent is a fail-closed aggregate readiness dimension rather than an informational field.
Production deploy, provider mutation, database mutation, migration apply, grant mutation, workflow dispatch and secret reads remain false.
